def createClusteredDesignDict(original_design: dict, cluster_piece_ids: list[str], design_name: str) -> dict:
    """Creates a clustered design from selected piece IDs.
    Returns dict with clusteredDesign and externalConnections.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️createclustereddesigndict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/createClusteredDesignDict)
    """
    pieces = original_design.get("pieces") or []
    connections = original_design.get("connections") or []
    if not pieces:
        raise ValueError("Original design has no pieces to cluster")
    if not cluster_piece_ids:
        raise ValueError("No piece IDs provided for clustering")
    cluster_set = set(cluster_piece_ids)
    clustered_pieces = [p for p in pieces if p.get("guid") in cluster_set]
    if not clustered_pieces:
        raise ValueError("No pieces found matching the provided IDs")
    internal_connections = [c for c in connections if c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set and c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set]
    external_connections = [c for c in connections if (c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set) != (c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set)]
    import uuid as _uuid
    import datetime as _datetime
    now = _datetime.datetime.now(_datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    clustered_design = {
        "guid": str(_uuid.uuid4()),
        "name": design_name,
        "unit": original_design.get("unit"),
        "description": f"Clustered design with {len(clustered_pieces)} pieces",
        "pieces": clustered_pieces,
        "connections": internal_connections,
        "createdAt": now,
        "updatedAt": now,
    }
    return {"clusteredDesign": clustered_design, "externalConnections": external_connections}

def replaceClusterWithDesignDict(original_design: dict, cluster_piece_ids: list[str], clustered_design: dict, external_connections: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Returns a DesignDiff that replaces clustered pieces with a design reference.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️replaceclusterwithdesigndict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/replaceClusterWithDesignDict)
    """
    connections = original_design.get("connections") or []
    cluster_set = set(cluster_piece_ids)
    pieces_to_remove = [{"guid": gid} for gid in cluster_piece_ids]
    connections_to_remove = [{"guid": c.get("guid")} for c in connections if c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set or c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set]
    updated_external = []
    for conn in external_connections:
        conn = dict(conn)
        connected_in = conn.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set
        connecting_in = conn.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set
        if connected_in:
            connected = dict(conn.get("connected", {}))
            connected["designPiece"] = {"guid": clustered_design.get("guid")}
            conn["connected"] = connected
        elif connecting_in:
            connecting = dict(conn.get("connecting", {}))
            connecting["designPiece"] = {"guid": clustered_design.get("guid")}
            conn["connecting"] = connecting
        updated_external.append(conn)
    return {"pieces": {"removed": pieces_to_remove}, "connections": {"removed": connections_to_remove, "added": updated_external}}

def getClusterableGroupsDict(design: dict, selected_piece_ids: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
    """Returns groups of piece IDs that can be clustered together.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️getclusterablegroupsdict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/getClusterableGroupsDict)
    """
    if len(selected_piece_ids) < 2:
        return []
    connections = design.get("connections") or []
    adjacency: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for c in connections:
        src = c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid")
        tgt = c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid")
        if src and tgt:
            adjacency.setdefault(src, set()).add(tgt)
            adjacency.setdefault(tgt, set()).add(src)
    visited: set[str] = set()
    groups: list[list[str]] = []
    selected_set = set(selected_piece_ids)
    def dfs(pid: str, group: list[str]) -> None:
        if pid in visited:
            return
        visited.add(pid)
        group.append(pid)
        for neighbor in adjacency.get(pid, set()):
            if neighbor in selected_set and neighbor not in visited:
                dfs(neighbor, group)
    for pid in selected_piece_ids:
        if pid not in visited:
            g: list[str] = []
            dfs(pid, g)
            groups.append(g)
    piece_guids = set(p.get("guid") for p in (design.get("pieces") or []))
    has_design_nodes = any(pid not in piece_guids for pid in selected_piece_ids)
    has_multiple = len(groups) > 1
    has_large = any(len(g) > 1 for g in groups)
    if has_design_nodes or has_multiple or has_large:
        return [selected_piece_ids]
    return []

def expandDesignPiecesDict(design: dict, kit: dict) -> dict:
    """Expands design references in connections into actual pieces.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️expanddesignpiecesdict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/expandDesignPiecesDict)
    """
    connections = design.get("connections") or []
    has_design_conns = any(c.get("connected", {}).get("designPiece") or c.get("connecting", {}).get("designPiece") for c in connections)
    if not has_design_conns:
        return design
    expanded = dict(design)
    design_ids: set[str] = set()
    for c in connections:
        dp = c.get("connected", {}).get("designPiece")
        if dp:
            design_ids.add(dp.get("guid", ""))
        dp = c.get("connecting", {}).get("designPiece")
        if dp:
            design_ids.add(dp.get("guid", ""))
    if not design_ids:
        return expanded
    for did in design_ids:
        try:
            ref_design = _findDesignInKitDict(kit, did)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        ref_expanded = expandDesignPiecesDict(ref_design, kit)
        new_pieces = [dict(p, center=p.get("center") or {"u": 0, "v": 0}) for p in (ref_expanded.get("pieces") or [])]
        new_conns = list(ref_expanded.get("connections") or [])
        updated_conns = []
        for c in (expanded.get("connections") or []):
            c = dict(c)
            if (c.get("connected", {}).get("designPiece") or {}).get("guid") == did:
                connected = dict(c.get("connected", {}))
                connected.pop("designPiece", None)
                c["connected"] = connected
            if (c.get("connecting", {}).get("designPiece") or {}).get("guid") == did:
                connecting = dict(c.get("connecting", {}))
                connecting.pop("designPiece", None)
                c["connecting"] = connecting
            updated_conns.append(c)
        expanded = dict(expanded, pieces=list(expanded.get("pieces") or []) + new_pieces, connections=updated_conns + new_conns)
    return expanded

    """Finds an attribute value on an entity by key.

def createClusteredDesignDict(original_design: dict, cluster_piece_ids: list[str], design_name: str) -> dict:
    """Creates a clustered design from selected piece IDs.
    Returns dict with clusteredDesign and externalConnections.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️createclustereddesigndict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/createClusteredDesignDict)
    """
    pieces = original_design.get("pieces") or []
    connections = original_design.get("connections") or []
    if not pieces:
        raise ValueError("Original design has no pieces to cluster")
    if not cluster_piece_ids:
        raise ValueError("No piece IDs provided for clustering")
    cluster_set = set(cluster_piece_ids)
    clustered_pieces = [p for p in pieces if p.get("guid") in cluster_set]
    if not clustered_pieces:
        raise ValueError("No pieces found matching the provided IDs")
    internal_connections = [c for c in connections if c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set and c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set]
    external_connections = [c for c in connections if (c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set) != (c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set)]
    import uuid as _uuid
    import datetime as _datetime
    now = _datetime.datetime.now(_datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    clustered_design = {
        "guid": str(_uuid.uuid4()),
        "name": design_name,
        "unit": original_design.get("unit"),
        "description": f"Clustered design with {len(clustered_pieces)} pieces",
        "pieces": clustered_pieces,
        "connections": internal_connections,
        "createdAt": now,
        "updatedAt": now,
    }
    return {"clusteredDesign": clustered_design, "externalConnections": external_connections}

def replaceClusterWithDesignDict(original_design: dict, cluster_piece_ids: list[str], clustered_design: dict, external_connections: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Returns a DesignDiff that replaces clustered pieces with a design reference.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️replaceclusterwithdesigndict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/replaceClusterWithDesignDict)
    """
    connections = original_design.get("connections") or []
    cluster_set = set(cluster_piece_ids)
    pieces_to_remove = [{"guid": gid} for gid in cluster_piece_ids]
    connections_to_remove = [{"guid": c.get("guid")} for c in connections if c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set or c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set]
    updated_external = []
    for conn in external_connections:
        conn = dict(conn)
        connected_in = conn.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set
        connecting_in = conn.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid") in cluster_set
        if connected_in:
            connected = dict(conn.get("connected", {}))
            connected["designPiece"] = {"guid": clustered_design.get("guid")}
            conn["connected"] = connected
        elif connecting_in:
            connecting = dict(conn.get("connecting", {}))
            connecting["designPiece"] = {"guid": clustered_design.get("guid")}
            conn["connecting"] = connecting
        updated_external.append(conn)
    return {"pieces": {"removed": pieces_to_remove}, "connections": {"removed": connections_to_remove, "added": updated_external}}

def getClusterableGroupsDict(design: dict, selected_piece_ids: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
    """Returns groups of piece IDs that can be clustered together.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️getclusterablegroupsdict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/getClusterableGroupsDict)
    """
    if len(selected_piece_ids) < 2:
        return []
    connections = design.get("connections") or []
    adjacency: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for c in connections:
        src = c.get("connecting", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid")
        tgt = c.get("connected", {}).get("piece", {}).get("guid")
        if src and tgt:
            adjacency.setdefault(src, set()).add(tgt)
            adjacency.setdefault(tgt, set()).add(src)
    visited: set[str] = set()
    groups: list[list[str]] = []
    selected_set = set(selected_piece_ids)
    def dfs(pid: str, group: list[str]) -> None:
        if pid in visited:
            return
        visited.add(pid)
        group.append(pid)
        for neighbor in adjacency.get(pid, set()):
            if neighbor in selected_set and neighbor not in visited:
                dfs(neighbor, group)
    for pid in selected_piece_ids:
        if pid not in visited:
            g: list[str] = []
            dfs(pid, g)
            groups.append(g)
    piece_guids = set(p.get("guid") for p in (design.get("pieces") or []))
    has_design_nodes = any(pid not in piece_guids for pid in selected_piece_ids)
    has_multiple = len(groups) > 1
    has_large = any(len(g) > 1 for g in groups)
    if has_design_nodes or has_multiple or has_large:
        return [selected_piece_ids]
    return []

def expandDesignPiecesDict(design: dict, kit: dict) -> dict:
    """Expands design references in connections into actual pieces.
    [👤semio📚py💻semio🔖domain🔖kitoperations🔖clustering🛠️expanddesignpiecesdict](semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/py/f/semio.py/s/Domain/s/Kit%20Operations/s/Clustering/d/i/expandDesignPiecesDict)
    """
    connections = design.get("connections") or []
    has_design_conns = any(c.get("connected", {}).get("designPiece") or c.get("connecting", {}).get("designPiece") for c in connections)
    if not has_design_conns:
        return design
    expanded = dict(design)
    design_ids: set[str] = set()
    for c in connections:
        dp = c.get("connected", {}).get("designPiece")
        if dp:
            design_ids.add(dp.get("guid", ""))
        dp = c.get("connecting", {}).get("designPiece")
        if dp:
            design_ids.add(dp.get("guid", ""))
    if not design_ids:
        return expanded
    for did in design_ids:
        try:
            ref_design = _findDesignInKitDict(kit, did)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        ref_expanded = expandDesignPiecesDict(ref_design, kit)
        new_pieces = [dict(p, center=p.get("center") or {"u": 0, "v": 0}) for p in (ref_expanded.get("pieces") or [])]
        new_conns = list(ref_expanded.get("connections") or [])
        updated_conns = []
        for c in (expanded.get("connections") or []):
            c = dict(c)
            if (c.get("connected", {}).get("designPiece") or {}).get("guid") == did:
                connected = dict(c.get("connected", {}))
                connected.pop("designPiece", None)
                c["connected"] = connected
            if (c.get("connecting", {}).get("designPiece") or {}).get("guid") == did:
                connecting = dict(c.get("connecting", {}))
                connecting.pop("designPiece", None)
                c["connecting"] = connecting
            updated_conns.append(c)
        expanded = dict(expanded, pieces=list(expanded.get("pieces") or []) + new_pieces, connections=updated_conns + new_conns)
    return expanded

def getPrimitiveDesignDict(kit: dict, design_guid: str) -> dict:

        current = _findDesignInKitDict(kit, current["parent"]["guid"])
